note: Models stay local (never in the repo). Only finished render frames are committed. Labels are enforced by rules tests when wired into the film. Local file paths live in local-paths.json (gitignored).

owner_rulings.2026-11-13: Full firearm assemblies are stand-ins (representative) except the AR-15, ACR and M249 models, which are Mark's own. Stand-ins are used only because Mark's own full-assembly models are not available to him.
